name: get_read_rate
description: RFID read rate from the latest full store count: raw and adjusted (excluding suspected loose tags) against the 95% target, by category, plus SKUs that come up short count after count (a sign of shrink).

filter.description: Optional category to narrow to, e.g. bra or legging

name: list_swap_outs
description: Floor items that can no longer hold their size run on their fixture and need a replacement, from this morning's floor scan. Each has a link to the Floorset page that ranks replacements and stages the swap for approval.

filter.description: Optional fixture or zone name, e.g. Zone 1 or Men's Table 1

name: list_loose_tags
description: Suspected loose RFID tags (tags still reading after the garment is gone, which hides shrink): counts, hotspot areas, and the most suspicious tags with confidence and the signals behind it.

filter.description: Optional store area, e.g. Fitting Room
